question: What will be the Cali Fund's total deposits received, in US dollars, as shown on the UNDP MPTF portal on October 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Portal total is $7,085 from 3 SME contributors (Nov 2025, Jul 2026, Oct 2026): ~1 deposit per 6-7 months, so the base rate of a new deposit in an 11-day window is ~6%. I raise this for COP17 (19-30 Oct) pressure and the two pending pledges ($3,571), which would put the total near $10.7k if paid. Contributions are voluntary, industry cites legal uncertainty, no country incentivizes payments, and no new deposits have been announced at COP17 so far. I estimate ~60% that the figure stays at 7085. Large deposits (>$100k) look unlikely, ~3-5%, with ~1% above $2M. No prediction market found (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi searched).

- Question background (mid-Oct 2026): portal total deposits ~$7,085, total source of funds ~$7,092 (gap is presumably interest, which does not count toward deposits).

- thecalifund.org 2026-07-31: Prozomix was the second contributor (covering 2025-2026).
- Cali Fund newsletter 2026-10-15: E-BIOM was the third contributor and commits 0.1% of eDNA service value annually from 2027. No dollar totals given; frames these as precedents for scaling up.
- El Espectador 2026-10-20: CBD Executive Secretary Schomaker called the uptake 'obviously disappointing'. Barriers: voluntary nature, legal uncertainty / double payment under the Nagoya Protocol (65 countries implement it); 70+ developing countries object to the 'donation' framing.
- AFP: no country has laws incentivizing contributions. IFPMA (pharma) cites design/implementation questions.
- LSE Grantham estimate of potential: $929M-$3.6B per year across ~22,000 eligible firms.
- COP17 in Yerevan, 19-30 Oct 2026: expected to set thresholds and rates and the distribution formula. The EU co-hosts a session on full and prompt implementation. Searched for announced new corporate deposits at COP17: none found as of 2026-10-20.
- Status quo: total deposits stay at 7085.
- Deposit pace: 3 deposits in ~20 months of operation, roughly 1 per 6-7 months; in the last year, deposits came in Nov 2025, Jul 2026 and Oct 2026.
- Resolution: resolves off the 'Total Deposits' line on mptf.undp.org/fund/cal00 (live UNDP ledger), not off pledges or press announcements.
- Event window: cumulative total through 2026-10-31; as of 2026-10-20, ~11 days remain.
- Prediction markets: none found.

An 11-day window gives a low base rate of a new deposit, which I raise for COP17 (Oct 19-30) announcement pressure and $3,571 in pledges from two companies that have not been deposited (AFP, Oct 20). Pushing the other way: contributions are voluntary, industry cites double-payment and legal uncertainty, there is a ledger posting lag, and no COP17 deposits have been announced. calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: (1) E-BIOM's amount, $1,134 (portal) vs $1,085 (AFP). The deposits sum to 7,085 only with $1,085, so the deposits figure is 7,085 either way, and the difference does not matter for the forecast. (2) TierraViva's deposit date, Nov 2025 vs Feb 2026: cannot be settled without web access, and it changes the deposit pace only slightly. Judgment disputes: P(no change) was ~55-65% across the runs; I take ~62% because I weigh posting lag and the absence of any COP17 announcement. The 90th percentile ranged from 22k to 55k; I lean toward the thinner tail (20k) because a large deposit would have to both arrive and post by Oct 31. I carry Run 3's dispersion forward. No web retrieval this run.

disagreements.verdict: The deposits sum of 7,085 implies $1,085; the $1,134 is likely a different FX conversion or line. Immaterial.
